display.purpose: Hero headline (700), section headings and card titles (600).

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and reading content (chat bubbles, explainer answers).

label.purpose: Domain tags, milestone chips, grade labels, footer line.

shadows.name: blaze-glow
shadows.purpose: The one elevation device in the system: primary button hover/focus and the stamped-confirmation motion.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: One-time staggered entrance for route waypoints on initial paint. Additive only.

motion.name: trail-draw
motion.purpose: The dashed connector between homepage waypoints draws in from its marker.

motion.name: stamp
motion.value: 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), scale 1->1.22->0.94->1 with a blaze-glow punch
motion.purpose: Physical confirmation feedback when a waypoint marker's state actually changes.

motion.name: landing-hero-appear
motion.value: staggered .appear entrances (scale/soft/mask/pop/btn/side/stat variants), 1.05s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), delays 0.08s-1.44s, resting opacity 1, backstopped by a JS fallback that force-reveals if the animation never runs
motion.purpose: One-time entrance choreography for the homepage-only landing hero (badge, headline, lede, CTAs, stats). Replaced the old canvas/SVG line-field hero entirely; scoped to '/' via page.module.css, never globals.css.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call-to-action treatment. Fully rounded, mono uppercase label, blaze glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #a94a18; color: #f5f5f2; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7e3712; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(224,136,56,0.4), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(224,136,56,0.45); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary, lower-emphasis action next to a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #161613; color: #a3a39c; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2c2c26; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped tag/suggestion. Inactive: outline-only. Active: fills with blaze.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #1d1d19; color: #a3a39c; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2c2c26; font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.name: Waypoint Marker
components.description: Signature component: a numbered, difficulty-graded route marker, now filled from a light-to-black tonal scale instead of three hues.
components.css: .ds-waypoint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-waypoint--beginner { background: #e5e5df; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-waypoint--intermediate { background: #8a8a80; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-waypoint--advanced { background: #1a1a16; color: #f5f5f2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #3d3d35; }

components.name: Card / Panel
components.description: The one elevation step in the system — a Surface rectangle with a hairline border, 20px radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161613; color: #f5f5f2; padding: 24px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2c2c26; } .ds-card__label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #a3a39c; }

components.name: Chat Bubble
components.description: Assistant and user message bubbles, both dark now — distinguished by fill step and alignment, not by a light/dark inversion.
components.html: Tell me what you're trying to learn.
components.css: .ds-bubble { display: inline-block; max-width: 80%; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-bubble--assistant { background: #161613; color: #f5f5f2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2c2c26; } .ds-bubble--user { background: #c85a1f; color: #f5f5f2; margin-left: auto; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Multi-state selector. Active pill takes the one blaze accent; inactive pills are outline-only.
components.css: .ds-pill { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #a3a39c; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2c2c26; background: transparent; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-pill--active { background: #c85a1f; color: #f5f5f2; box-shadow: none; }

narrative.overview: PathFinder redesigned as a route marked after dark: a near-black field, a single warm blaze of light cutting through it, everything else rendered in the grayscale of a headlamp beam. Direction was set from a concrete reference the team pointed to (a dark, monochrome, high-craft AI-product site) rather than rolled from a blind concept seed. Product truth, copy, the PathFinder name, and the waypoint/route/trail vocabulary are unchanged — this is a visual-world redesign, not a repositioning.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground throughout — homepage and app screens alike, no light surface left anywhere
Exactly one saturated accent, brightened for legibility on near-black, used only for the primary action and active/confirming states
Difficulty grading as a light-to-black tonal scale instead of three hues
Zilla Slab pushed to 700 weight for the one hero statement per page; everything else at 600
A generative line-field hero visual as the one place the system spends real technical ambition

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blaze is the only saturated color anywhere in the product. Secondary emphasis is carried by text weight/tone and underline, never a second hue.

rules.name: The Graded-Not-Colored Rule
rules.body: Difficulty is a light-to-black tonal scale, never separate hues and never generic status colors.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label ever sits directly above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The One-Glow Rule
rules.body: Only the blaze glow exists as elevation anywhere in the system; every other surface separates with a hairline border, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One-Surface Exception
rules.body: The homepage ('/') carries its own pure-black, liquid-metal landing-hero system (Inter/Instrument Serif, glass buttons, single viewport) built from a second concrete reference. It is the only page allowed to deviate from Night Trail's tokens; catalog/chat/dashboard/profile stay on Night Trail.

dos: Do keep Blaze to the one saturated accent per screen and per product.
Do express difficulty through the light-to-black tonal scale everywhere.
Do let headings carry their own weight — no eyebrow/kicker labels.
Do separate surfaces with a hairline border first; reach for the glow only for the primary action and the stamp motion.
Do reuse the waypoint-marker language for any future sequence, timeline, or progress UI.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent for links, secondary actions, or intermediate grading.
Don't use a black drop shadow on a near-black ground — it disappears; use the glow or a border.
Don't bring back a light/cream surface anywhere, including inputs or nested chips.
Don't fabricate integration/partner logos to imply endorsements PathFinder doesn't have.
Don't extend the landing hero's black/liquid-metal system past '/', and don't put invented adoption/traction stats in its footer — every stat there must be a true product fact.
